text:
Nvidia’s market value crossed $4 trillion on July 9, 2025, driven by strong demand for its Blackwell accelerator (GB200/GB300 rack systems), the Stargate project's ~$500 billion AI-infrastructure plan, and repeatedly raised capital expenditure guidance from hyperscalers including Microsoft, Meta, Google, and Amazon throughout 2025 [Source: ev-1]. This milestone indicates that investors are pricing AI infrastructure as the largest new capital cycle since the internet era, with Nvidia positioned as a central "toll-booth" in this spending supercycle [Source: ev-1].

The rapid valuation trajectory highlights the scale of recent growth, moving from $1 trillion in mid-2023 to $2 trillion in February 2024, $3 trillion in June 2024, and finally $4 trillion in July 2025 following a significant price run in early July 2025 when shares crossed approximately $160 [Source: ev-1]. This surge reflects CEO Jensen Huang’s framing of an industry transition toward inference demand and "AI factories," while also underscoring risks related to Nvidia's record weight in the S&P 500 and its rotation within the elite group of companies valued at or above this threshold alongside Apple and Microsoft during 2025 [Source: ev-1].
